name: baby-safe-room
description: ベビーセーフ・ルーム — 家庭内事故予防を学ぶトップビュー・シミュレーションゲーム

scripts.test:stage3: npm run build && npm run build:3d && node tests/browser-stage3.mjs 2d && node tests/browser-stage3.mjs 3d
scripts.check:pure: grep -rnE 'document\.|window\.|canvas|CanvasRenderingContext|THREE|requestAnimationFrame|Math\.random' src/game/ && echo 'NG: src/game references DOM/Canvas/Math.random' && exit 1 || echo 'OK: src/game is pure'
